lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr3Si adopts the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194) with a cell formula of Cr6Si2 and eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Cr center has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cr, 4 Si) with distances 2.58–2.63 Å, while each Si center has 12 Cr neighbors at 2.59–2.63 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Cr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Cr- and Si-centered polyhedra.
